historical_reviews.deepseek: Hybrid classification accepted; older/downgrade image is not equivalent to deliberately corrupt capsule.

original_test_intent: Verify AST1060/PFR rejects a deliberately malformed or integrity-corrupted BMC capsule for the explicitly selected active or recovery update path before any unsafe write/activation, leaving firmware, recovery content and boot health unchanged.
original_method: Capture PFR lifecycle, active/recovery versions/hashes and BMC health; create/obtain a validly attributable capsule with one documented corruption type while preserving a known-good original; approve exact target path; isolate system and ready golden/programmer recovery; submit once; capture parser/signature/integrity rejection stage/status/event; prove neither active nor recovery region staged/written/activated and BMC services remain healthy.
manual_activity: Owner supplies/approves the precisely corrupted capsule, target path and recovery; agent may submit once and verify rejection/no mutation.
required_inputs: Known-good capsule plus documented corruption method/location and hashes
Exact active or recovery update endpoint/path and expected rejection stage/error/event
Stable isolated SUT, console, golden image/programmer rollback
safety_requirements: Validate corruption and target offline; preserve known-good image
Perform one attempt with stable power and independent recovery
Stop if write/stage/activation/reboot begins or region hash changes
Never target both regions ambiguously, retry, or clear evidence
agent_execution_scope: Submit one approved corrupt capsule and capture full task/events
Verify active/recovery content/state and services unchanged
Do not generate uncontrolled image, choose target, allow mutation, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve corruption type and exact target region/path
Approve rejection stage/status/event and no-write evidence
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: An older image tests anti-rollback, not corruption; `mc info` alone cannot prove neither active nor recovery region was written.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-approved update endpoint once with a capsule whose single documented integrity/signature/format corruption reaches the intended validation gate.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Corrupt capsule, active/recovery target language and AST1060 rejection remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Diff a known-good/corrupt capsule, target one approved update path, and bind the exact rejection event to immutable pre/post region evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reproducible corruption, exact region, layered rejection semantics, no-write proof and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An older valid image exercises SVN policy, while arbitrary truncation may fail client-side; neither automatically proves the AST1060 corruption gate named here.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If validation occurs after staging or the wrong path is selected, recovery content can be damaged and normal boot evidence alone may hide it.

project_override_considerations: Choose active and recovery path coverage explicitly; if both are required, treat them as separately authorized subchecks with recovery verification between them.
expected_evidence: PFR state and active/recovery version/hash baseline
Good/corrupt capsule hashes and documented binary difference
Proof no stage/write/activation or region/version/config change
Final BMC boot/services and rollback readiness plus engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and Criteria consistently request AST1060 rejection of a corrupt BMC update image; active/recovery target selection is pending scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The negative test is conditionally executable with a controlled corrupt capsule, exact target and recovery.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2281 Wistron-HW-00247-V003: approve BMC/AST1060/PFR build/lifecycle and whether active, recovery or separately both paths are in scope; known-good capsule and exact reproducible corruption type/location with hashes; expected parser/signature/integrity rejection stage, task/status/error/PFR event and timeout; required proof of no staging/write/activation or active/recovery hash/version/config change; stable power, isolated target and golden/programmer rollback.

review_improvement: Keeps corrupt-capsule rejection separate from adjacent SVN downgrade coverage and requires evidence that both boot-critical regions remain untouched.
independent_technical_reasoning: Update pipelines validate container format, metadata, signature, payload digest, compatibility and security version at different layers. The corruption must be designed so the intended AST1060/PFR gate is exercised rather than rejected by the client before submission. Since the source names active/recovery regions, acceptance evidence must include exact target selection and pre/post region state—not just a surviving BMC version string. Any unexpected staging is a critical recovery event.
